item.title: How to Reduce Household Expenses: 14 Cuts Ranked by Real Savings
item.description: Cutting household expenses is not about willpower — it is about attacking the few shared costs that actually move the number, in the order that pays back fastest. For most households, four categories (housing, utilities, groceries, and subscriptions) swallow the majority of the budget, and a weekend of phone calls plus one system change is usually worth $200–$400 a month.
